name: opencode-security-guard
description: Defense-in-depth security controls for OpenCode V2: reduce the risk that an LLM coding agent reads, exposes, modifies, or transmits sensitive local data.

scripts.check: node --check plugin/security-guard.js && node scripts/validate.mjs && node scripts/scan-secrets.mjs

opencode.note: V2 is a beta; re-run scripts/doctor.mjs after every OpenCode upgrade.
